name: Walach Harkon
canonNotes: The Vampire who took Blood Keep by challenging and slaying or turning its knights; he learned war from Abhorash, the first Blood Dragon.
Claims to seek honour and glory, but truly craves to overpower the mightiest warrior on any field and to trample the unworthy.
voiceNotes: Proud, knightly in manner and challenging; speaks of duels, worth and glory.
Contempt for the weak; respect only for a worthy opponent.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
